# Igor Ganapolsky Public Offers

This site contains buyer-facing offers and public product pages from Igor Ganapolsky.

## Primary Offer: ApplyOps Resume Truth Snapshot

ApplyOps is a same-day resume risk audit for senior software, AI, platform, Android, and data candidates who are getting ignored or ghosted despite strong experience.

- Landing page: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/
- Partner / acquisition brief: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/partners.html
- Sample audit: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/applyops/sample-truth-snapshot.html
- Senior engineer resume audit guide: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/topics/senior-engineer-resume-truth-audit.html
- AI resume and ATS risk audit guide: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/topics/ai-resume-ats-risk-audit.html
- Products API: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/api/products.json
- Public offer feed: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/offers.json

### What ApplyOps Does

- Flags unsupported or inflated resume claims.
- Checks ATS readability and target-title fit.
- Identifies bullets that create recruiter doubt.
- Rewrites the four weakest bullets without fabricating credentials, employers, dates, degrees, titles, or metrics.

### Paid Offers

- Resume Truth Snapshot: $49 one-time audit.
- Resume OS Pro: $149 one-time 30-day resume and application workspace.
- Done-For-You Sprint: $1,500 two-week managed job-search operations sprint.

## Public Brand Page

- Ralph Resume OS: https://igorganapolsky.github.io/ralph-resume-os/

Ralph Resume OS is the private workflow layer behind ApplyOps. Public pages intentionally avoid publishing private application data, implementation details, source artifacts, secrets, or operational runbooks.

## Safety And Integrity

ApplyOps does not guarantee employment, fabricate credentials, invent metrics, or submit applications when required facts are unknown.
